note: Search API block provides one Block plugin 'search_api_form_block' rendering a search input that submits (GET by default) to an existing Search API view page. There is no settings form/configure route; all state is on the placed block config entity block.block.<id> under settings (schema block.settings.search_api_form_block): action_url (Search page path, must start with /), action_method (get/post), input_name (exposed filter machine name, defaults to keys), input_placeholder, submit_value, input_label, input_label_visibility, pass_get_params. Medium cases place a fixed block sab_known and read its settings back via drush; hard cases have the agent place a block and verify the config entity's plugin+settings. All fixtures are namespaced sab_* / block.block.sab_* and removed on cleanup/reset.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site using Search API, I want to add a search input block that submits to my Search API search view. Which block plugin does the search_api_block module provide (its plugin id), and does it run the search itself?
evals.expected_output: It provides the block plugin 'search_api_form_block' (admin label 'Search API form'). It does not run the search itself; it submits (GET by default) to an existing Search API view page whose path you configure as the block's action_url.

evals.prompt: In the search_api_block 'Search API form' block, which two settings control the search page path it submits to and the name of the search input, and what does the input name need to match?
evals.expected_output: action_url (the 'Search page' path, must start with a slash) and input_name (the name of the search input, which should match the target view's exposed keyword filter machine name, e.g. keys). Also selectable: action_method (get/post) and pass_get_params.

evals.prompt: The search_api_block search form submits via GET but its result URLs stay clean. Which form fields does the module hide so they do not end up in the search URL?
evals.expected_output: search_api_block_form_search_api_form_alter() sets #access = FALSE on form_build_id, form_token and form_id, so a GET submit does not carry those into the resulting search-page URL.

evals.prompt: This site has a placed Search API form block whose block id is 'sab_known'. Inspect its live configuration and report the Search page path (action_url) it submits to.
evals.expected_output: block.block.sab_known settings.action_url is '/sab-search' (plugin search_api_form_block). Read it with: drush cget block.block.sab_known settings.

evals.prompt: This site has a placed Search API form block with block id 'sab_known'. Inspect its live configuration and report the input name (input_name) it uses for the search field.
evals.expected_output: block.block.sab_known settings.input_name is 'custom_keys'. Read it with: drush cget block.block.sab_known settings.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site (search_api_block is enabled), place a Search API form block with the block id 'sab_task' that submits via GET to the search page '/sab-results', using the input name 'search'. Save it so it exists in configuration.
evals.expected_output: A block config entity block.block.sab_task exists with plugin 'search_api_form_block' and settings.action_url='/sab-results', settings.action_method='get', settings.input_name='search'. Create it e.g. with Block::create([...])->save().

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site (search_api_block is enabled), place a Search API form block with block id 'sab_adv' that submits to '/sab-adv-results' using the POST method, has the 'Pass GET parameters' option turned on, and uses input name 'q'. Save it to configuration.
evals.expected_output: A block config entity block.block.sab_adv exists with plugin 'search_api_form_block' and settings.action_url='/sab-adv-results', settings.action_method='post', settings.pass_get_params=true, settings.input_name='q'.
